_README: Copy this to ops/leg_roads.json (gitignored) and fill the roads with REAL host:port addresses. This repository is public, so the real file is never committed -- the same rule as ops/local_peers.txt. covenant_legpaths.py reads it. Each leg lists its roads IN PREFERENCE ORDER: the first that answers is used, the rest are fall-through. Within a leg roads are tried in order; legs are read in parallel. Any HTTP reply (incl. 429) counts as the leg answering (A115).

node_D._roads_note: road 0 = hosted tailnet (direct); road 1 = our headscale, served by laptop_hs_relay.py (127.0.0.1:15082 -> SOCKS 127.0.0.1:1057 -> tetsu-hs -> node D); road 2 = TETSU's own plane, served by a second relay instance to its SOCKS. Keep the REAL file out of git.
